verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in AI email assistant that handles delegated work inside the product. It auto-labels and auto-archives mail, writes replies using inbox, calendar and web context, and turns jotted phrases into full emails in your voice. It also answers natural-language questions via Ask AI, takes plain-language instructions, and supports user-built agents that run on triggers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-app AI features, and clear evidence of free-form multi-step task delegation through an in-app chat (the agent builder may belong to the broader Superhuman platform rather than Mail specifically).
